messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert — service="inference-gateway" region=us-west1 metric=5xx_error_rate value=12.4% -> paging SREs. Incident: INC12345 https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

marta: Acked. I'm oncall for this shift, taking the page and moving to this thread.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by marta (On-Call). Escalation paused.

sre-jordan: seeing 502s upstream from kvcache eviction + proxy flaps in us-west1-a. Starting proxy restart on affected pods and warming cache.

sre-jordan: ```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-proxy-usw1 --timeout=5m
# watching pod status...
```

eng-anna: Support: spike on /v1/generate — customers AcmeCorp and NovaApps reporting failures. CS queue shows repeating errors, linking tickets: https://tickets.example/TKT-451

marta: Routing change: shifting 30% traffic -> eu-west1 standby, 70% -> us-west1 standby pool. Enabling fallback-model-small for latency-sensitive routes to avoid long tail retries.

ops-lee: Recommend reducing client retries and enabling circuit breaker to avoid thundering herd. Pushing config now.

ops-lee: ```
service.cfg:
  retries: 1
  circuit_breaker_threshold: 0.2
```

pagerbot: incident-bot: paused canary traffic for ongoing rollout in us-west1. Autoscaling remains enabled.

sre-jordan: Proxy restart done on 3/3 pods, kvcache warmup in progress. Observed 5xx rate drop: 12.4% -> 4.1% over last 3m. Latency stable.

eng-anna: Customer impact notes: AcmeCorp ~40% client-side errors (most retries failing), NovaApps ~15%. Account teams notified; CS has posted mitigations to both. Tentative ETA for full recovery 20-30m depending on cache warmup.

marta: :thumbsup: Good. Keep watch on 5xx and p90 latency. If error rate <= 1% for 10m with no recurrences, we'll resolve PD. I'll do a handoff note for next oncall.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Alert INC12345 auto-resolved (no active incidents). Please confirm recovery before closing internal postmortem.
